tools.name: localproof.resolve_jurisdiction
tools.description: Free. Resolve one address or place to a supported LocalProof jurisdiction and coverage state before deeper research. Use this when jurisdiction support is unknown; use get_coverage to inspect published coverage without resolving a property. Held or unsupported jurisdictions fail closed before paid w

tools.name: localproof.get_coverage
tools.description: Free. Return released and held jurisdiction and operation coverage without querying property records. Use this to plan routing; use resolve_jurisdiction when you have a specific address.

tools.name: localproof.get_source_catalog
tools.description: Free. Return registered authoritative sources and freshness expectations for a jurisdiction. Use this to understand evidence sources; use get_source_health for current endpoint reachability.

tools.name: localproof.get_source_health
tools.description: Free. Probe registered official-source reachability for a jurisdiction without returning source records. Use this for current source availability; use get_source_catalog for source identity and freshness expectations. Reachability is not completeness.

tools.name: localproof.check_property_changes
tools.description: Paid $0.03 USD. Find timestamped changes after an ISO 8601 since value across released evidence dimensions for a resolved property, currently comprehensive in San Francisco. Use this for repeat polling; use check_permits for current permit detail or build_property_intelligence_pack for a full curren

tools.name: localproof.check_permits
tools.description: Paid $0.09 USD. Reconcile current official permit records for one resolved property where permit coverage is released. Use this for permit detail; use check_permit_routing for San Francisco review routing and holds or build_property_intelligence_pack for cross-source context. Unsupported or held jur

tools.name: localproof.check_permit_routing
tools.description: Paid $0.25 USD. Trace released San Francisco permit review routing, departments, holds, timing, and recorded outcomes. Use this for administrative routing state; use check_permits for permit records. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

tools.name: localproof.check_parcel_context
tools.description: Paid $0.06 USD. Return privacy-minimized official parcel and land-use attributes where a supported parcel source is released. Use this for parcel facts; use check_zoning_context for released zoning context or build_property_intelligence_pack for cross-source context. Unsupported or held jurisdiction

tools.name: localproof.check_planning_activity
tools.description: Paid $0.25 USD. Reconcile released planning applications and entitlement activity for one property. Use this for planning records; use check_zoning_context for current zoning context or build_property_intelligence_pack for multi-source context. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

tools.name: localproof.check_code_enforcement
tools.description: Paid $0.25 USD. Reconcile released code-enforcement and complaint records for one property. Use this for enforcement evidence; use build_property_intelligence_pack for a broader package. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

tools.name: localproof.check_zoning_context
tools.description: Paid $0.01 USD. Return released official zoning context for a resolved property. Use this for zoning evidence, not a proposed-use or legal determination; use check_parcel_context for parcel attributes. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

tools.name: localproof.build_property_intelligence_pack
tools.description: Paid $0.25 USD. Build the broad released multi-source property package with completeness, source gaps, provenance, and repeat-poll guidance through check_property_changes. Use this for a comprehensive current property view; use focused check_* tools when only one evidence class is needed. Unsupporte

tools.name: localproof.compare_sites
tools.description: Paid $0.49 USD. Compare two or three distinct candidate San Francisco sites across the same released evidence dimensions without selecting a winner. Use this for side-by-side site evidence; use build_property_intelligence_pack for one site. Unsupported or held jurisdictions fail before payment.

tools.name: localproof.build_development_due_diligence
tools.description: Paid $2.95 USD. Build the deepest released San Francisco development evidence package with cross-source chronology, attention items, completeness, source gaps, provenance, and repeat-poll guidance through check_property_changes. Use this for development due diligence; use build_property_intelligence
